# Restoration — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots run).** Endgame build (level 60), 0/8/43 — respec at level 60. The decision loop walks 91 rules in ascending priority and executes the first whose condition is true. The party fixtures place this spec on level 51 (1 member), level 60 (8 members). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/shaman/restoration/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

**Measured in round 155** (amp-6's per-spec table). **WEAK** — HPS 247 → 142: ~half of a healer's combat decisions are totem drops (tkb-play) [measured].

**This page is the bots' half.** It records what our party bots actually run for this spec — the level-60 build and the level-by-level order, the rule firing order the decision loop walks, the kit bands, the round-155 measurement and the recorded deviations. The hand-written guide for this spec is [restoration.md](./restoration.md).

## How the bots play it

On every decision tick the loop walks the rules in ascending `priority`, executes the first one whose condition is true and skips the rest of that tick. The groups below are a reading aid; the priority numbers are the real order. Level is the rule's own `level_min` — the first level it can fire.

### Single target

- **85 — Lesser Healing Wave** (`SR09a-lesser-healing-wave-emergency`) — level 20+ · intent `filler` · spell 8004
  - **When:** target health below 35%; the resident is not moving; at least 105 mana.
  - **Why:** HO-TKB-PLAY-024 (owner idea via the orchestrator: cast time against time to death).
  - Sources: [restoration.md § Healing rotation (raid) (L99)](restoration.md#healing-rotation-raid); [restoration.md § Healing rotation (raid) (L108)](restoration.md#healing-rotation-raid); [leveling.md § Levels 20–29 (L165)](leveling.md#levels-20-29); [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/shaman/restoration/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `doc research/tkb/play/r35-boss-heal.txt`].

## Situational notes from the rule notes

Every sentence below is copied from a rule's own note (the rule id is in front of it) and mentions a situation the rule exists for. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here; their items are in the band table above.

- **SR00u-mana-oil — Apply Brilliant Mana Oil:** The spec's own guide page names it (line 3); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **SR00u-mageblood — Use Mageblood Potion:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Mageblood Potion (item 20007, required level 40), elixir or potion (aura 24363 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 160); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **SR00u-tea — Use Nordanaar Herbal Tea:** Restores 525 health and 810 mana (spell 19398, instant) and shares its 120 s category 1172 with the Dark and Demonic Runes; the guide names it as the mana cooldown beside the potions.
- **SR00u-dreamshard — Use Dreamshard Elixir:** Out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it, until its aura is up (HO-TKB-PLAY-205 shape).
- **SR00c-water-breathing-pre-swim — Water Breathing:** HO-TKB-PLAY-144 (round 131 BFD-C, p4-pioneer water.py: party uptime submerged 77.6%, the shaman's 18 Water Breathing casts spread 4/4/4/3/3 with 4 on a druid already in Aquatic Form while the mage was covered 35.6% of her time underwater): at a swim stretch (party.swim_ahead, p4-group 343) every member enters with at least five minutes of Water Breathing: a buff placed for an earlier stretch ran out in the next one.
- **SR00b-water-breathing — Water Breathing:** HO-TKB-PLAY-144 (round 131 BFD-C, p4-pioneer water.py: party uptime submerged 77.6%, the shaman's 18 Water Breathing casts spread 4/4/4/3/3 with 4 on a druid already in Aquatic Form while the mage was covered 35.6% of her time underwater): covered_by [5697, 1066] (v30): a member in Aquatic Form or carrying the other breath buff is skipped. HO-TKB-PLAY-139 (owner, 2026-10-08: the party's shaman or warlock buffs every member before a swim and refreshes it while the party is underwater; druids use Aquatic Form for their own swims): Water Breathing (131, instant, 10 min, 30 yd) on every member, the resident included, who lacks it or has under two minutes left (party_missing with refresh_below_ms, v28), while the party walks or holds at a swim stretch (party.swim_ahead, p4-group 343) or any member is submerged; in combat too, since a buff running out mid-fight underwater is how a member drowns.
- **SR00p-spirit-link-tank-boss — Spirit Link:** HO-TKB-PLAY-179 (PIONEER FIX, amp-3 audit r2, orchestrator): Spirit Link on the tank at a boss pull. 405 mana and cooldown_ready(51363) make it one cast per boss pull; the in-combat rule stays as the emergency. party.pull_is_boss reads the pull window only (the tank's pull stamped at most 10 s ago, not yet in combat), so it is false in a fight.
- **SR06-ancestral-spirit — Ancestral Spirit:** OQ-2765 asks the same check this workstream's own priest measured: this rule sat at priority 60, after every buff (SR01-SR05) but before the heal ladder, so a dead ally competed only with Water Shield, Lightning Shield, Earth Shield, Ancestral Swiftness and Spirit Link for the tick, not with Chain Heal or either Healing Wave - but it still sat below this file's own SR00-drink (5) and SR00a-eat (6), and it has not measured wrong the way the priest's H13 did only because no shaman is on a stream yet (OQ-2803). `mana_pct >= 36` is new, and the unit is why it is not 90: `manaCostPercentage` is a share of BASE mana (Spell::CalculatePowerCost) while `mana_pct` binds to the CURRENT pool (state-vocabulary.yaml), and this workstream's only measured conversion is the priest's - H12-dispel-magic's 18 per cent of base costing exactly 85 mana off a 1190-point bar gives a 2.48 pool-to-base ratio (HO-TKB-PLAY2-001 section 3, which uses the identical 2.48 to infer the shaman's own pool at 505 base times 2.48).
- **SR01-water-shield — Water Shield:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **SR02-lightning-shield — Lightning Shield:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **SR03-earth-shield — Earth Shield:** HO-TKB-PLAY-166 (PIONEER FIX, p4-group, round 144): the three shields exclude each other on this core, each cast removes the one up, so a rule that asks only for its own aura loops: SR03 laid Earth Shield, SR01 put Water Shield back, SR03 again, one cast every 1.5 s out of combat (423 and 422 casts in 77 minutes on one level-51 healer, 85-93k mana each, no drink because the loop kept the pool empty). Earlier: Turtle content at 40: 200 mana, 10 min, an aura rather than a totem, and - this is the correction - it lands on the shaman and not on the tank.
- **SR04a-swiftness-healing-wave — Healing Wave:** HO-TKB-PLAY-245 (PIONEER FIX, tkb-play endgame specs programme, owner order 2026-10-18): Ancestral Swiftness then max-rank Healing Wave as the instant emergency heal (guide L100, L23, L108): once SR04 has cast Ancestral Swiftness (aura 16188 up) the next heal on a target under 35 percent is the highest-rank Healing Wave, not the Lesser Healing Wave of SR09a (which stays the emergency heal when Ancestral Swiftness is on cooldown, L108 "elif target HP < 35 percent: Lesser Healing Wave (max)").
- **SR05m-mana-spring-totem — Mana Spring Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-131 (p4-pioneer decision 189 (d), rotation gaps for tracks 2 and 3 at 26 and 28: no Mana Spring Totem): "Water Shield + Mana Spring at 26 help a LOT", "Totems: Healing Stream (20) for chip damage, Mana Spring (26)" (shaman/leveling.md L160, L167). Both are water totems: under 60 per cent mana with nobody under 50, Mana Spring takes the slot, and SR05b does not put Healing Stream back over it while it stands.
- **SR05c-tremor-totem — Tremor Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): Tremor Totem while a member is feared (party.any_feared): "Tremor on fear fights" in the earth slot instead of Strength of Earth, which yields while anyone is feared (restoration.md L125; enhancement.md L163).
- **SR05a-strength-of-earth-totem — Strength of Earth Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): yields the earth slot to Tremor (SR05c) while a member is feared. The 20-29 dungeon healer's totems include "Strength of Earth for melee" (shaman/leveling.md L167); the bot-ready loop drops the totem set first (restoration.md L108).
- **SR05b-healing-stream-totem — Healing Stream Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): yields the water slot to Poison Cleansing (SR05d) while a member carries a poison. In combat while someone is hurt and nobody is in an emergency; guards as SR05a; 30 yd is its own radius (totem 3907 casts 6372, SpellRadius 10).
- **SR05d-poison-cleansing-totem — Poison Cleansing Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): Poison Cleansing Totem while a member carries a poison (party.any_dispellable(4)): "Poison/Disease Cleansing when needed" (restoration.md L126; enhancement.md L163 "add cleansing ... totems as needed"). Deadmines: Poisoned Harpoon, 2-3 a round.
- **SR04b-grounding-totem-zevrim — Grounding Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-187 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator): the dungeon guide for Dire Maul says of Zevrim Thornhoof: "Shaman: re-drop Grounding Totem immediately after it is consumed, and pre-place it" ([dire-maul.md](../../instances/dire-maul.md), the Zevrim line). His Sacrifice (22651) is a 1 s cast on a random member; a Grounding Totem eats one spell aimed at the party, so it is the cheap answer to a landed Sacrifice (a teleport, an 8 s stun and a 300 per second leech).
- **SR04c-tremor-totem-halgan — Tremor Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-187 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator; amp-6's Dragonmaw strategy item 1): Halgan Redbrand (62069) casts ONE Psychic Scream, a fear, when his health first falls to 50 per cent (boss_halgan_redbrand.cpp L54-L58 at the pin: `!m_bUsedPsychicScream and GetHealthPercent() <= 50`, cast on his victim). The old Tremor Totem rule waits for `party.any_feared`, i.e. until the fear has landed; Tremor Totem pulses every 3 seconds and breaks a fear in progress, so a totem already down when he screams ends it at once.
- **SR05e-totemic-recall — Totemic Recall:** HO-TKB-PLAY-245 (PIONEER FIX, tkb-play endgame specs programme, owner order 2026-10-18): Totemic Recall once the fight is over and the party is not resting: "drop totems, heal the pack, recall and move" (guide L17, L96). Refunds 25 percent of the mana of each totem (DB base points 24); the party leaving its rest hold (or never resting) stands in for "move" (no movement term for the party exists).
- **SR05f-windfury-totem — Windfury Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-343 (v43 party rules, orchestrator order 2026-10-18): Windfury Totem for a melee group (restoration.md L124 "Windfury in a melee group"; HO-TKB-PLAY-245 proposal P245-3): party.melee_count >= 1 is the page's "a melee group" (the page gives no count, open question). HO-TKB-PLAY-396 (round-155 performance verdict, resto shaman HPS 247 to 142, totem rules about half of the healer GCDs): the totem goes down before the pull (party.pull_imminent, as SR05b, HO-TKB-PLAY-045) and in combat only while nobody is under 80 per cent, so a re-drop never takes a heal GCD from a member in need.
- **SR05h-flametongue-totem — Flametongue Totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-396 (round-155 performance verdict, resto shaman HPS 247 to 142, totem rules about half of the healer GCDs): the totem goes down before the pull (party.pull_imminent, as SR05b, HO-TKB-PLAY-045) and in combat only while nobody is under 80 per cent, so a re-drop never takes a heal GCD from a member in need.
- **SR08m-cure-disease-must — Cure Disease:** HO-TKB-PLAY-186 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator: owner ruling, meaningful dispels not random; decision 214's principle): the MUST-REMOVE half. amp-5's DB study (harmful player debuffs per dungeon, 2026-10-16: 41 of about 120 removable debuffs are must-remove: control, charm, silence, fear, heal and cast slows, the heavy damage-over-time curses and diseases) names the ids, and this rule removes them by id, high in the ladder so it reacts fast, reading the heal target today (the afflicted member only when it is the heal target; p4-group's view will aim it). The generic cleanse further down the file is now 'when free': below every heal rule and behind a 50 per cent mana floor, so a trivial debuff never costs a heal or the mana for one.
- **SR07m-cure-poison-must — Cure Poison:** HO-TKB-PLAY-186 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator: owner ruling, meaningful dispels not random; decision 214's principle): the MUST-REMOVE half. amp-5's DB study (harmful player debuffs per dungeon, 2026-10-16: 41 of about 120 removable debuffs are must-remove: control, charm, silence, fear, heal and cast slows, the heavy damage-over-time curses and diseases) names the ids, and this rule removes them by id, high in the ladder so it reacts fast, reading the heal target today (the afflicted member only when it is the heal target; p4-group's view will aim it). The generic cleanse further down the file is now 'when free': below every heal rule and behind a 50 per cent mana floor, so a trivial debuff never costs a heal or the mana for one.
- **SR09a-lesser-healing-wave-emergency — Lesser Healing Wave:** MEASURED, rounds 27-35 (r35-boss-heal.txt): Grennik started 207 Healing Waves (2.25 s) and the target died before 22 of them landed (10.6 per cent), 16 of those 22 at under 35 per cent health when started; a 35 line moves 53 of the 185 that lived to the 1.5 s heal.
- **SR09-chain-heal — Chain Heal:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **SR11-lesser-healing-wave — Lesser Healing Wave:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **SR11b-lesser-healing-wave-topup — Lesser Healing Wave:** ONE GAP THIS RULE DOES NOT CLOSE, RECORDED RATHER THAN HIDDEN: Lesser Healing Wave carries no aura of its own (it is a direct heal, not a heal-over-time), so unlike the priest's H09b, which reuses Renew's `not aura_target(139)` as a per-target repeat guard, this rule has NO way to say "I already topped this target up a moment ago" - the vocabulary's only such guard is an aura check (OQ-2517), and a direct heal leaves nothing to check. Mana guard, same two parts as the priest's H09b and for the same reason: `mana_pct >= 30`, at least as strict as this file's three dispel reserves (SR07/SR08/SR12, OQ-2803, OQ-2519), because this is the lowest-urgency heal in the file; and `mana >= 105`, Lesser Healing Wave's own rank-1 cost, the same absolute floor SR11-lesser-healing-wave already uses (spell_template 8004, SR11's own cite).
- **SR07-cure-poison — Cure Poison:** Instant, 30 yd, and above the heals because a poison left on is a heal spent every tick - but not free, which is what the earlier note said. manaCost 0 with manaCostPercentage 9 is 9 per cent of BASE mana at every level (Spell::CalculatePowerCost), about 45 at level 25 against a base of 505, which is measurable: HO-TKB-PLAY-003 watched the priest's Dispel Magic take exactly its 18 per cent, 85 mana, off a level-24 bar in one cast. The reserve is the same 30 that pass put on the priest's three cleanses and it is carried rather than re-derived, because no shaman has appeared on a stream and the pool the percentage would be measured against is unknown (OQ-2803).
- **SR08-cure-disease — Cure Disease:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **SR13e-earth-shock-t1 — Earth Shock:** HO-TKB-PLAY-398 (p4-group for amp-4 r155-perf-roles.md GAP 4a, round 155 Scholomance: a restoration shaman has no Earth Shock rule; Earth Shock 8042 30 mana, instant, 20 yd, 6 s category, second effect SPELL_EFFECT_INTERRUPT_CAST, spell_template via realm query): the elemental ladder SE13-earth-shock-t1 (HO-TKB-PLAY-183/192/193) for the healer, placed BELOW every heal and cure rule (heals end at 117), so a kick is taken only on a tick where no heal rule is true, and behind a 40 per cent mana floor.

## What the bots do not do (from the rule notes)

Sentences from the rules' notes that say what is deliberately not implemented, or that name an open question.

- **SR00u-dreamshard:** "Dreamless/Dream elixir" (L160): read as the Dreamshard Elixir (the amp-2 audit's reading; Dreamless Sleep Potion 12190 is a sleep potion, not a healing elixir): open question 2.
- **SR05f-windfury-totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-343 (v43 party rules, orchestrator order 2026-10-18): Windfury Totem for a melee group (restoration.md L124 "Windfury in a melee group"; HO-TKB-PLAY-245 proposal P245-3): party.melee_count >= 1 is the page's "a melee group" (the page gives no count, open question).
- **SR05g-grace-of-air-totem:** HO-TKB-PLAY-343 (v43 party rules, orchestrator order 2026-10-18): Grace of Air with no melee in the group ("Grace of Air only in a double-shaman group or with no melee", restoration.md L124); the double-shaman case has no term (party.has_class(7) is true with the resident itself: open question).
- **SR10h-healing-wave-heavy-levelling:** The 50 percent bar is the band SR10 already uses for its top-up cap, not a guide figure (open question: the guide says only "big hits").
